title: Regolith Reservoir
description: Simulate sand falling through a cave with rock walls and an optional floor.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse rock paths into a set of filled `(x, y)` coordinates. Sand drops from `(500, 0)` and tries to move down, then down-left, then down-right. If all three are blocked, it settles.

## Part 1

Simulate sand grains until one falls past the lowest rock (into the void). Count how many grains settled.

## Part 2

Add an infinite floor at `max_y + 2`. Simulate until sand blocks the source at `(500, 0)`. The floor prevents sand from falling into the void, so the cave fills up completely.
